agent_assumptions: Plan top edge = North, bottom edge = South, left = West, right = East (no compass mark provided; inferred from matching South elevation door position (x=3.44-4.64) to plan bottom-row door, and North elevation window pattern to plan top-row 3-window pattern).
Wall thickness ~0.24m per plan annotations; modeled as zero-thickness representative planes at wall centerlines (cells abut at shared coordinate).
Ground floor (F1) height 3.0m, first floor (F2) height 3.6m, total 6.6m, per East/West elevation vertical dimension breakdown (3600+3000 blocks split by a mid slab line).

Window sill/head heights: F1 windows z=[1.0,2.6] (1.6m tall, 1.0m sill) and F2 windows z=[4.0,5.8] (1.8m tall, 1.0m sill above its floor), read from elevation vertical dimension chains 1000/1600/400 and 1000/1800/800.
Door heights assumed 2.1m for interior doors, 2.4m for the two exterior glazed doors (South main entrance, West corridor entrance) per elevation door height chains.

Interior room-to-corridor door exact widths/positions along the shared wall are approximated (~0.9m, placed near the partition where arc marks were observed); precise jamb offsets not individually measured.

F2 office-to-corridor door exact positions approximated as centered in each office's corridor wall span; plan shows small jamb-detail dimensions (360/660) suggesting doors near partitions, but exact side not fully resolved from available crops.
East facade has a window (not door) into the corridor on both floors; West facade has a door into the corridor on F1 and a window in the same position on F2, per East_view/West_view comparison.
